scope: Persistent local signing, guarded installation and real native permission retention. No recording, model calls or Messages changes.
limitations: The one-time migration from the previous ad-hoc identity needed initial permission approvals.
No physical Fn press, microphone capture or end-to-end cloud dictation was performed in this permission-retention check.
The actual app update changed sealed build metadata; different executable code was also checked separately using compiled signing probes.
privacy: Private screenshots, paths, permission database blobs, keychain and generated passwords are not committed.
